status.summary: Validation vector: the engine reproduces the manual's plaintext at 66 of 68 positions.

found_by: Frode Weierud (PDF of the manual and HTML transcription)
signature: Reproduced in Soler Fuensanta and López-Brea Espiau, Mensajes secretos (2018), pp. 512-513
sender: The manual's worked example; not a transmission
body: RCHB FZZK NVJX TUAY NZKW RUHC HPSX KKWL ZMBY NVWV GUMC WZMJ VEEP ZQXF DWFH RIRR ZHXC
notes: Not an intercept: the manual enciphers a text of its own, without the header and closing check of the indicator procedure. It gives the key itself: rotor order II-III-I, Ringstellung QDRR, windows MNAS, the drums numbered 0 to 3 from left to right, reflector first. The two divergent letters are isolated and do not move under any change of stepping: a slip in the hand computation of 1936 or in the transcription. On wiring D the match is at chance level. Numerals are bracketed by NR and XK and keyed from the top row (python/sarmiento.py, rule 7): TWTP = 5250, OTPPPP = 950000.

solution.plaintext_emended_note: The two divergent positions emended, as the manual prints the text.
solution.reading: ENEMIGO CARECE MUNICIONES APRESAMOSLE NR 5250 XK DE CAÑON Y NR 950000 XK FUSIL [WWW]

divergences.note: Isolated and fixed under any change of stepping: a slip in the source, not a defect of the model.
